findings.finding: 7 duplicate top-level `revised_at` keys (lines 8,10,12,14,16,18,21,23). A strict duplicate-key YAML parser fails on the canonical artifact; the effective value is parser-dependent (PyYAML keeps the last). Treating revision history as repeated keys makes `revised_at` ambiguous for any tool that does not implement last-wins.
findings.recommendation: Keep one `revised_at` and move the delta history into a `revision_history:` list or comments. Systemic: F2a has 8 duplicates, F1 has 7 `revised_at` + 2 `revised_at_unused`.
